arguments.text: Fixed. A flag no longer gets an implicit `False` default when it is `required`, so `cli` with no args now errors with "Missing option '--on'".

Fixed. When there is no console stream (pythonw), `click.echo` now returns silently, the progress bar falls back to an in-memory buffer, and the pager does the same instead of crashing with AttributeError.
Fixed. For a flag with `flag_value`, a set env var now yields the configured flag value (`UPPER=whatever cmd` prints `upper`); boolean flags still parse the env var value as before.
Fixed. `click.argument(...)` (like `click.option(...)`) no longer mutates its own kwargs, so a decorator reused on several commands keeps passing `cls=` to every one of them.
Fixed. `Path(resolve_path=True)` now resolves via `pathlib.Path(...).resolve()`, so a relative symlink target resolves against the link's directory: `/tmp/demo/link` gives `/tmp/demo/real.txt`.
Fixed. The boolean-flag default shown in help now uses the effective default (including `default_map`), so `foo --help` says `[default: name]` when the map sets it to True.
